items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Well Young asked for a raise. I said, "You got to be out of your mind, man.

ctx.x: And, I'll tell you, Meil Young was on the piano in that band. And, so, McKinney's Cottonpickers came in town. And, Roy Eldridge and Joe Eldridge's brother and all of the cats in -- in -- what was the drummer's name? Cubie Austin?
